name: [🌩️UPD] Steal From The Rich!
desc:
💎 Welcome to Steal From The Rich!


How to Play:
📦 Steal crates from the rich
💰 Collect valuable items like treasures
🏡 Build and decorate your dream base with your stolen treasures!
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill and base
⚡ Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
✨ Reach richer areas and discover greater treasures!


⭐ Like & Favorite the game so you don’t miss future updates, new areas, pets, treasures and events!
❤️ Every Like helps support the game and lets us know you want more updates!


🎮 Supports Desktop, Mobile, Console and Tablet players
